label: preparing
what: Builder and innkeeper are coordinating an evening community hospitality gathering in the town hall, with bread catering and lantern lighting. Freight assists with paid delivery and baker supplies a large bread order; neighbour witnessed payment and heard an offer of two hundred fresh loaves. The programme is to be announced at eighteen on day 1. Preparations were initially unexplained to me, but secretary has now conveyed the stated occasion and invitation; any further purpose remains unknown.
